content.title: Where to watch the Detroit Pistons vs. Los Angeles Lakers for free tonight
content.text: Updated: Mar. 23, 2026, 5:00 p.m.Published: Mar. 23, 2026, 5:00 p.m.Los Angeles Lakers guard Nick Smith Jr. (20) and Detroit Pistons guard Marcus Sasser (25) fight for possession of the ball during the first half of an NBA basketball game Tuesday, Dec. 30, 2025, in Los Angeles. (AP Photo/Caroline Brehman) APAPIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe Detroit Pistons are back in action tonight to host the Los Angeles Lakers at Little Caesars Arena. Fans can catch the cross-conference action at 7 p.m. ET on FanDuel Sports Network Detroit as well as TV 20 Detroit for local fans, with streaming options available through Fubo and DirecTV Stream. Both streaming services offer free trials and first-month discounts for new customers. FanDuel Sports Network Streaming OptionsAll columns visible (no scrolling needed)The Pistons have officially clinched a playoff spot and remain at the top of the Eastern Conference with a 51-19 record. They’re in the midst of a three-game winning streak, following their 115-101 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Friday. Jalen Duren led the team in the win with 23 points. The Lakers are in third place in the Western Conference with a 46-25 record. They’re currently on a nine-game winning streak, following their most recent 105-104 victory over the Orlando Magic.
